# autter_dashboard (Resource)

A Runtime dashboard of a repository. Addressed by its name within the repository. Runtime dashboards must be turned on for the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "autter_repository" "web" {
  full_name = "acme/web"
}

resource "autter_dashboard" "checkout" {
  repository_id = data.autter_repository.web.id
  name          = "Checkout health"

  variables = {
    service = "checkout"
    range   = "24h"
  }

  widgets = [
    {
      id       = "errors"
      title    = "Server errors by route"
      viz      = "bar"
      source   = "errors"
      measure  = "count"
      group_by = ["route"]
      filters = [
        # One value: value. A number is fine; Autter compares number columns as numbers.
        { field = "status_code", op = "gte", value = 500 },
        # A list, for in and not_in: values.
        { field = "environment", op = "in", values = ["production", "staging"] },
      ]
    },
    {
      id      = "latency"
      title   = "p95 latency"
      viz     = "line"
      source  = "spans"
      measure = "p95"
      field   = "duration_ms"
    },
    {
      id     = "slowest"
      title  = "Slowest routes"
      viz    = "table"
      source = "sql"
      sql    = "SELECT route, max(duration_ms) AS slowest FROM runtime_spans GROUP BY route ORDER BY slowest DESC LIMIT 10"
    },
  ]

  # Optional: left out, every widget gets its default size in widget order.
  layout = [
    { id = "errors", w = 6, h = 2 },
    { id = "latency", w = 6, h = 2 },
    { id = "slowest", w = 12, h = 2 },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The dashboard's name, unique in the repository: the API addresses it by name. Changing it replaces the resource (a rename is a delete and a create). If a dashboard with this name already exists, it is adopted.
- `repository_id` (String) The repository: its id, usually `data.autter_repository.<label>.id`. Its full name (`owner/repo`) also works, but after an import the id is stored, so use the id to keep plans clean. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `widgets` (Attributes List) The widgets, at most 24 (may be empty). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--widgets))

### Optional

- `layout` (Attributes List) Where each widget goes. Left out: every widget at its default size, in widget order (Autter fills it in; that is not a change). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layout))
- `variables` (Attributes) The dashboard's variables, applied to every widget. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the dashboard was created (ISO 8601).
- `created_by` (String) The id of the member who created the dashboard; null for one Autter created.
- `id` (String) The dashboard's id in Autter. Informational: the provider addresses it by repository and name.
- `updated_at` (String) When the dashboard was last changed (ISO 8601). It does not move when an apply changes nothing.

<a id="nestedatt--widgets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widgets`

Required:

- `source` (String) `logs`, `spans`, `errors`, `metrics`, `llm` or `sql`.
- `title` (String) The widget's title.
- `viz` (String) `line`, `bar`, `stat` or `table`.

Optional:

- `field` (String) The field the measure reads. Left out: the source's default (Autter fills it in; that is not a change).
- `filters` (Attributes List) Up to 10 filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--widgets--filters))
- `group_by` (List of String) Up to 3 columns to group by.
- `id` (String) 1 to 40 letters, digits, dashes or underscores. Left out: `w1`, `w2`, … by position. Give every widget an id or none.
- `measure` (String) `count`, `rate`, `p50`, `p95`, `p99` or `sum`. Required unless `source` is `sql`.
- `sql` (String) For `source = "sql"`: one read-only SELECT.

<a id="nestedatt--widgets--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widgets.filters`

Required:

- `field` (String) The column.
- `op` (String) `eq`, `neq`, `contains`, `not_contains`, `starts_with`, `in`, `not_in`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt` or `lte`.

Optional:

- `value` (String) One value. A number (`value = 500`) is accepted and sent as text; Autter compares number columns as numbers. Set `value` or `values`, not both.
- `values` (List of String) A list of 1 to 50 values, for `in` and `not_in`. This is the API's `value` when it is a list.



<a id="nestedatt--layout"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layout`

Required:

- `h` (Number) Height in rows, 1 to 4.
- `id` (String) The widget's id.
- `w` (Number) Width in columns of 12.


<a id="nestedatt--variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables`

Optional:

- `environment` (String) Only this environment; `all` for every environment. Left out: every environment except test ones.
- `range` (String) The time range: `1h`, `6h`, `24h` (the API's default), `7d` or `30d`.
- `service` (String) Only this service.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = autter_dashboard.checkout
  id = "acme/web:Checkout health"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is "<repository>:<name>".
terraform import autter_dashboard.checkout "acme/web:Checkout health"
```
